coverage.reason: Move Crown purchases from Skins into a dedicated adjacent Shop tab and remove the shared Earn Crowns button. Exercise real Shop navigation and four-tab keyboard focus, server-provided pack quantity/price, existing artwork, live/test purchase review, order recovery/status, account isolation, unavailable/sign-out states, wallet refresh focus and desktop/landscape card layout. Stabilize the existing payment-policy captures by positioning each section after font loading without a competing URL-fragment scroll. Existing Shop tests cover provision buying and rewarded-ad dependencies; cosmetics tests cover the changed shared skin-panel layout, purchase/equip and Profile views. Server authority and contracts are unchanged.

Bound the new Crown Shop presentation to a 4 KiB source-growth allowance and 18 KiB combined payment UI cap while reusing the existing Crown icon. Production validation and shared asset budgets check entry resources, optional Shop resources, cache/versioning and total build limits.

Record the owner-confirmed Buy Crowns tab, icon/pack/price/Buy presentation and Earn Crowns removal; retain established pickup rewards. No independent runtime tests apply to this design note; its implementation and dependencies are covered above.
